title: •Flash Of Insight
caption: •Flash Of Insight (V)
game_text: Deploy on table. Play with the top card of your Reserve Deck revealed (if possible). During your draw phase, place this Effect in Used Pile and you may retrieve 1 Force.
lore: Occasionally Han was capable of such feats, even without Threepio there to tell him these things.
